label: GPT-6.1 Terra
output:
Hi Mum, Kirsty and Linda!

I’ve got a wee surprise planned for Gran before her birthday dinner, so keep this to yourselves for now!

Morag’s said I can have Hair by Morag to myself on Saturday 12 December after she closes at 12. I thought it’d be lovely to get us all together there from 1pm and do everyone’s hair for free before we head out for Gran’s 80th dinner that night. I’m absolutely buzzing about it!

That’s me, Mum, Kirsty, Linda and Gran, plus Ava and Ruby — seven heads for me to work my magic on! The wee ones can get braids and glitter spray if they fancy it. I reckon they’ll love that.

I can do a cut and blow-dry for everyone, no bother. If you’d like a colour though, can you let me know what you’re after **by Friday 27 November**? I’ll need time to order everything in from the wholesaler. If I don’t hear by then, it’ll just be a cut and blow-dry on the day.

Gran said at Easter she’d love to go silver properly but wouldn’t pay salon prices, so I’d love to chat to her about that when she gets there and see what’s possible. And Linda, the good news is we won’t be doing yours in your kitchen this time — the cooker and the dog are safe! 😂

Mum, could you be in charge of getting Gran to the salon for 1 without telling her why? You’re probably our best bet for getting her there without her getting suspicious!

Dinner’s booked for 8.30 at the Italian on Byres Road. There’ll be nine of us at the table, including Uncle Davie and Kirsty’s man, so we’ll have plenty of time to get ready and head over.

Bring a bottle of fizz if you fancy it too — Morag says it’s fine as long as we tidy up after ourselves.

Let me know what you all want done, and remember the colour deadline! Can’t wait to spoil Gran and have a wee afternoon together before dinner ❤️
